subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should trusted hook-agent callers be allowed to re-enter an existing stored session when they explicitly select persistent mode and pass the current request-session-key and prefix checks?
rationale: This cannot be settled mechanically because it changes the product security boundary from an isolated external turn to access to an existing conversation transcript and identity.

options.title: Allow explicit persistent mode
options.body: Permit opt-in reuse behind existing hook authentication and narrowly bounded session-key prefixes, while preserving isolated behavior by default.

options.title: Keep all hooks isolated
options.body: Reject transcript reuse and update the public webhook contract to state that stable session keys do not preserve conversation history.

recommendation.title: Allow explicit persistent mode
recommendation.body: Permit opt-in reuse behind existing hook authentication and narrowly bounded session-key prefixes, while preserving isolated behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter’s prior review already framed the preferred compatibility shape and the exact security boundary requiring confirmation.
